_comment: HAND-WRITTEN FIXTURE. Modeled after PostgreSQL 16 EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON). Triggers 'row_estimate_mismatch'. Planner estimated 10 rows (e.g. stale stats after massive load), but actual execution returned 85,000 rows (8,500x underestimation). To generate on local Postgres: INSERT INTO logs SELECT generate_series(1, 100000); (do NOT run ANALYZE); EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM logs WHERE id > 15000;
